name: xo-server-affinity-manager
description: Tag-based affinity and anti-affinity management for XCP-ng

schedule.title: Enforcement Schedule
schedule.description: How often affinity rules are evaluated. 15min | hourly | daily (2 AM).

dryRun.title: Dry Run Mode
dryRun.description: When ON (default), logs all intended actions without moving any VMs. Turn OFF to enforce rules live.

nfsLogPath.title: Log Path
nfsLogPath.description: Absolute path to the log directory. Created automatically if it does not exist.
